title: Qualify real Math Foundation source compilation and identity under isolated .NET 11 C# 15
commitMessage: test: qualify Math Foundation source on isolated net11 C#15

contribution.summary: Compile and run the existing Math Foundation contract in an offline isolated .NET 11/C# 15 consumer without changing repository projects.
contribution.value: Copy the unmodified FoundationContract.cs into an ignored temporary net11.0 C#15 project pinned to SDK 11.0.100; perform offline restore, build and runtime identity assertion. This proves only the first source-level Math compatibility probe, not thirteen-package certification.
debtChanges: RS217 succeeded at attempt 001 after one durable preselection refusal; first-pass false, corrected source graph has 16 direct edges.
RS218 tests one actual Math Foundation source contract on isolated SDK11, reusing qualified toolchain discipline rather than changing project TFMs or creating new packages.
M8-W02-C01 remains not-ready. Existing net10 archives, package versions and SDK pins are immutable; no adoption or broader net11 compatibility is implied.
